title: Tangent space of a scheme over a field at a point, and the tangent map
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $x\in X$ be a point with residue field $\kappa=\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field], and let $\kappa[\epsilon]$ be the ring of dual numbers, the $\kappa$-algebra free on $1,\epsilon$ with $\epsilon^2=0$. The *tangent space* $T_{X/k,x}$ of $X$ over $k$ at $x$ is the set of morphisms of $k$-schemes $\theta:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon]\to X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] whose composite with the closed point $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon]$ (given by $\epsilon\mapsto0$) is the canonical morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)\to X$ at $x$; an element is a *tangent vector*. It carries its canonical $\kappa$-vector space structure: for $\lambda\in\kappa$, $\lambda\theta$ is $\theta$ precomposed with $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the $\kappa$-algebra endomorphism $\epsilon\mapsto\lambda\epsilon$ of $\kappa[\epsilon]$, and $\theta_1+\theta_2$ is the composite of $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon]\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2]$ (given by $\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2\mapsto\epsilon$, where $\kappa[\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2]$ has basis $1,\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2$ and all products of the $\epsilon_i$ zero) with the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2]\to X$ that restricts to $\theta_i$ along $\epsilon_i\mapsto\epsilon$, $\epsilon_{3-i}\mapsto0$ (it exists and is unique because $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2]$ is the pushout of two copies of $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon]$ along $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa$). If $f:X\to Y$ is a morphism of $k$-schemes and $y=f(x)$ is such that $\kappa(y)\to\kappa(x)$ is an isomorphism, the *tangent map* $\mathrm df:T_{X/k,x}\to T_{Y/k,y}$ induced by $f$ is $\theta\mapsto f\circ\theta$ (with $\kappa(y)$ identified with $\kappa(x)$); it is $\kappa(x)$-linear.

source.place: Varieties, Section 0B28: Definition 0B29 (dual numbers), Lemma 0B2B (vector space structure, proof), Definition 0B2C (varieties-definition-tangent-space) with S = Spec k, Lemma 0B2F (varieties-lemma-map-tangent-spaces, the linear map df)
